messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday on a Friday, Monday, or an observed holiday on a Monday when the holiday falls on a weekend.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day (observed) | Jan 2 | Mon | Jan 1–3 | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so it was observed on Monday. |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, BC, Ontario, NB, PEI) | Feb 20 | Mon | Feb 18–20 | All provinces that observe Family Day had it on Monday. |
| St. Patrick’s Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | Mar 17 | Fri | Mar 17–19 | NL’s statutory holiday. |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | Apr 7–9 | National holiday. |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | May 20–22 | National holiday. |
| St. Jean Baptiste Day (Quebec) | Jun 24 | Fri | Jun 24–26 | Quebec’s statutory holiday. |
| Canada Day (observed) | Jul 3 | Mon | Jul 1–3 | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so it was observed on Monday. |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | Sep 2–4 | National holiday. |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Mon | Oct 7–9 | National holiday. |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Mon | Nov 9–11 | National holiday. |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | Dec 23–25 | National holiday. |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tue | — | Not a long weekend (falls on Tuesday). |

**Key take‑aways for your app**

1. **Observed holidays**: If a holiday falls on a weekend, Canada typically observes it on the following Monday (e.g., New Year’s Day, Canada Day).  
2. **Provincial variations**: Some holidays (Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, St. Jean Baptiste Day) are province‑specific.  
3. **Long‑weekend windows**: The table lists the full three‑day span for each long weekend, which can be used to highlight travel opportunities in your UI.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the same information broken down by province or if you need additional details (e.g., exact times of observance, public‑transport closures, etc.).
